title: Analysis code for chromosomal phosphoethanolamine transferases as repeated and independent sources of mobilised colistin resistance in Enterobacterales
description: Analysis code, alignments, trees, topology test output, ancestral state reconstructions, codeml runs and detection results supporting a comparative genomic study of chromosomal phosphoethanolamine transferases and the mobilised colistin resistance (mcr) gene families.
